title: Compare To Constant
text: Determine how signal compares to specified constant, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Operator} sets Logical operator; {Constant value} sets the constant to compare, {Output data type} sets the data type and {Enable zero-crossing detection} selects to enable zero-crossing detection. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of the output boolean (default) | uint8
